title: Pure Buster Blader
summary: Buster Blader (Destruction Sword) is a lockdown combo deck aimed at summoning Buster Dragon alongside Buster Blader, the Dragon Destroyer Swordsman on the opponent's turn via Prologue of the Destruction Swordsman. Buster Dragon turns all opposing monsters into Dragons, while the Fusion forces all Dragons into Defense Position and prevents them from activating their effects.

allow.Where Arf Thou?: Searches any Level 1 Destruction Sword Whelp while you control Buster Whelp of the Destruction Swordsman.
allow.One for One: Discards a Destruction Sword card to Special Summon Buster Whelp directly from the Deck.
allow.Foolish Burial: Sends Buster Blader or Destruction Sword Memories to the GY to set up Prologue combos.
allow.Trap Trick: Banishes 1 Prologue of the Destruction Swordsman from the Deck to set another copy directly to the field.
allow.Protector Whelp of the Destruction Sword: Archetypal Link-2 monster that dumps a Destruction Sword card on Link Summon and Special Summons Buster Blader from hand.
allow.Linkuriboh: Converts Level 1 Buster Whelp or Dragon Buster Destruction Sword into a GY resource while protecting LP.

main: Buster Whelp of the Destruction Swordsman
Core starter that searches any Destruction Sword card on Normal Summon and tributes itself to summon Buster Blader.
Buster Blader
Iconic Level 7 Warrior required in the Deck/GY for Prologue of the Destruction Swordsman and Destruction Sword Memories.
Buster Blader, the Destruction Swordmaster
Treats its name as 'Buster Blader' on the field or in the GY and destroys opposing monsters to equip them.
Dragon Buster Destruction Sword
Equips to Buster Blader (via Buster Dragon) to completely lock the opponent out of Special Summoning from the Extra Deck.
Wizard Buster Destruction Sword
Equips to Buster Blader to prevent the opponent from activating monster effects in the GY.
Robot Buster Destruction Sword
Equips to Buster Blader to prevent face-up Spells/Traps the opponent controls from activating their effects.
Karma of the Destruction Swordsman
Banishes monsters of the same Type from the opponent's GY to boost ATK and discards a Destruction Sword card to recover itself.
Destruction Sword Memories
Trap that discards a Destruction Sword card to summon Buster Blader from Deck, and banishes from GY to Fusion Summon Dragon Destroyer Swordsman.
Prologue of the Destruction Swordsman
Core Trap that sends a Destruction Sword card and a Buster Blader from Deck to GY to cheat out Buster Dragon from the Extra Deck.
Destruction Sword Flash
Trap that banishes all monsters the opponent controls if you control a Fusion Monster that lists Buster Blader as material.
Emblem of Dragon Destroyer
Adds Buster Blader from the Deck or GY to the hand.
Trap Trick
Acts as copies 4-6 of Prologue of the Destruction Swordsman or Destruction Sword Memories.
Where Arf Thou?
Searches Dragon Buster Destruction Sword after Normal Summoning Buster Whelp.
One for One
Summons Buster Whelp or Dragon Buster Destruction Sword from the Deck.
Foolish Burial
Sends Buster Blader or Dragon Buster Destruction Sword to the GY.
extra: Buster Blader, the Dragon Destroyer Swordsman
Fusion boss that gains 1000 ATK/DEF per Dragon, forces all opponent's Dragons to Defense Position, and prevents them from activating effects.
Level 8 Synchro summoned by Prologue that turns all opponent's monsters into Dragons and equips a Destruction Sword from GY to Buster Blader.
Protector Whelp of the Destruction Swordsman
Link-2 that sends Destruction Sword Memories from Deck to GY on Link Summon and inflicts burn damage.
Link-1 used to send Buster Whelp to the GY when needed.
